ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let jsonResult = JSON.parse(result);
let data = [];

var Href = (contentId, id) => {
    let base = `${source.key}/chapter/${contentId}-${id}.html`;
    return `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(base)},{"type":"辞晨"}`;
};

var ChapterData = (item, isVolume) => ({
    title: item.chapterName,
    href: isVolume ? null : Href(item.contentId, item.id),
    time: item.createdAt.replace(/T.*/, ' '),
    volume: isVolume,
    vip: false
});

jsonResult.data.chapters.forEach(chapter => {
    data.push(ChapterData(chapter, false));
});
data.reverse();
JSON.stringify(data)
</js>
